label: Q-01
title: The `gross` clamp is provably redundant but fails SILENTLY rather than loudly; a future refactor that breaks its premise mints free phUSD instead of reverting
description: capped <= user.amount * scale implies gross == netWanted always. But netUsed clamps against netWanted and the frictionless target is sized on netWanted, so if the premise ever breaks the contract pays a target it did not debit for -- free phUSD -- rather than reverting. The comment's own justification ('the debit below underflows if it is ever wrong') is backwards: the debit uses `gross`, which is the clamped value, so it cannot underflow.
impact: Latent: correct today, silently wrong under a future refactor. QA.
severityBasis: QA. No value at risk at HEAD.
recommendation: require(gross == netWanted) so the premise fails loudly.
